1: // Minimal endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
10: 
11:   // Audio setup using Web Audio API
12:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
13:   // Helper to play a tone
14:   const playTone = (freq, duration = 0.1, type = 'square') => {
15:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
16:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
17:     osc.type = type;
18:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
19:     osc.connect(gain);
20:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
21:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
22:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
23:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
24:     osc.start(audioCtx.currentTime);
25:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
26:   };
27:   const playJumpSound = () => playTone(300, 0.08);
28:   const playCollisionSound = () => playTone(100, 0.3, 'sawtooth');
29: 
30:   // Game settings
31:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
32:   const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;
33:   const PLAYER_SIZE = 10;
34:   const OBSTACLE_WIDTH = 15;
35:   const OBSTACLE_GAP = 120; // distance between obstacles
36:   const OBSTACLE_SPEED = 3;
37:   const GROUND_HEIGHT = 20; // height of ground strip
38: 
39:   let score = 0;
40:   let frame = 0;
41: 
42:   const player = {
43:     x: 50,
44:     // Start on ground above the ground strip
45:     y: height - GROUND_HEIGHT - PLAYER_SIZE,
46:     vy: 0,
47:     width: PLAYER_SIZE,
48:     height: PLAYER_SIZE,
49:     onGround: true,
50:   };
51: 
52:   const obstacles = [];
53: 
54:   // Input – tap / click to jump
55:   const jump = () => {
56:     // Ensure audio context is running
57:     if (audioCtx.state !== 'running') audioCtx.resume();
58:     if (player.onGround) {
59:       player.vy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
60:       player.onGround = false;
61:       playJumpSound();
62:     }
63:   };
64:   canvas.addEventListener('click', jump);
65:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); jump(); });
66: 
67:   const spawnObstacle = () => {
68:     const height = Math.random() * (height * 0.5) + 20; // random height
69:     obstacles.push({
70:       x: width,
71:       y: height > height / 2 ? 0 : height - height, // simple top or bottom obstacle
72:       w: OBSTACLE_WIDTH,
73:       h: height,
74:     });
75:   };
76: 
77:   const update = () => {
78:     // Player physics
79:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
80:     player.y += player.vy;
81:     // Land on ground strip
82:     const groundY = height - GROUND_HEIGHT - player.height;
83:     if (player.y >= groundY) {
84:       player.y = groundY;
85:       player.vy = 0;
86:       player.onGround = true;
87:     }
88: 
89:     // Move obstacles
90:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
91:       const o = obstacles[i];
92:       o.x -= OBSTACLE_SPEED;
93:       // Remove off‑screen
94:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) {
95:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
96:         score++;
97:       } else {
98:         // Collision detection
99:         const collides =
100:           player.x < o.x + o.w &&
101:           player.x + player.width > o.x &&
102:           player.y < o.y + o.h &&
103:           player.y + player.height > o.y;
104:         if (collides) {
105:           // Play collision sound
106:           playCollisionSound();
107:           // Game over – stop animation
108:           cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);
109:           alert('Game Over! Score: ' + score);
110:           return;
111:         }
112:       }
113:     }
114: 
115:     // Spawn new obstacles at intervals
116:     if (frame % Math.round(OBSTACLE_GAP / OBSTACLE_SPEED) === 0) {
117:       spawnObstacle();
118:     }
119:     frame++;
120:   };
121: 
122:   const draw = () => {
123:     // Background gradient (sky)
124:     const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
125:     skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB'); // light sky blue
126:     skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#4682B4'); // steel blue
127:     ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
128:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
129: 
130:     // Ground
131:     const groundHeight = 20;
132:     ctx.fillStyle = '#654321'; // brown ground
133:     ctx.fillRect(0, height - groundHeight, width, groundHeight);
134: 
135:     // Player (draw as circle for smoother look)
136:     ctx.fillStyle = '#00FF00'; // bright green
137:     ctx.beginPath();
138:     ctx.arc(player.x + player.width / 2, player.y + player.height / 2, player.width / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
139:     ctx.fill();
140: 
141:     // Obstacles (random pastel colors)
142:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
143:       const hue = Math.floor(Math.random() * 360);
144:       ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 70%, 50%)`;
145:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
146:     });
147: 
148:     // Score (larger font, shadow)
149:     ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
150:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
151:     ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
152:     ctx.shadowOffsetX = 2;
153:     ctx.shadowOffsetY = 2;
154:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 30);
155:     // Reset shadow for next frames
156:     ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
157:   };
158: 
159:   let animationId;
160:   const loop = () => {
161:     update();
162:     draw();
163:     animationId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
164:   };
165:   loop();
166: })();

(End of file - total 166 lines)
